ticket.title: Add template version metadata and upgrade status command

objective: Add template version metadata and expose a CLI status command for safer multi-repo upgrades.

steps.action: Implement template metadata model and upgrade status evaluation logic.
Wire metadata writes into init flow and add template-status CLI command.
Document upgrade workflow and phase 3 adoption plan.

risks: Partial init runs may be misread as fully upgraded without explicit status messaging.
Version ordering can be ambiguous if non-numeric template version strings are introduced.
handoff_constraints: Keep metadata schema strict and deterministic.
